description: Expanded RAG retrieval benchmark for thesis experiments. Cases cover platform APIs, external API domains, generation rules, and common failure patterns.

cases.cleaned_text: 文档只写了 DELETE /coupon/{coupon_id}，没有说明 coupon_id 从哪里来，容易导致场景不可执行。
